FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Antique Treasures Emporium, our core operations center around the retail sale of high-quality antiques and collectibles. We specialize in unique, curated items ranging from furniture and home décor to rare collectibles, ensuring each piece holds historical significance and aesthetic appeal. Our inventory is meticulously stored and displayed in a climate-controlled environment, crucial for preserving the integrity of our sensitive items. To maintain the highest standards of quality, we document the provenance of every item, including appraisal values and condition notes, allowing us to offer our customers not only beautiful pieces but also assurance of their authenticity. Security is paramount; thus, we employ monitored alarm systems and secure display cases to protect our high-value items. Regular inventory audits take place to ensure all items are accurately recorded and assessed, supporting both our operational transparency and the needs of our insurance requirements.

Our antique and collectible store often features items displayed in various areas of the building, including some spaces that are not climate-controlled, allowing us to showcase a diverse range of unique pieces for our customers.
